message:
The other night, we had a surprise power outage just as I was settling in with my favorite book. Instead of feeling frustrated, I decided to embrace the moment. I gathered my trusty flashlights and my cozy blankets, and I made a little fort in the living room. I charged up my phone with a power bank and even popped some popcorn on my camping stove, turning the unexpected darkness into a cozy movie night! 

It reminded me that a little creativity can turn an inconvenience into a fun experience. Have you ever turned a blackout into a cozy event? I’d love to hear your tips!
